We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions, using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied first four templates, got some intermediates. Need to continue with template 1914399 then 74054, and ensure total reactions >=6. Also need to construct JSON tree representing route from target to precursors.

We need to see results of each step.

Step1: target SMILES: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

Applying template 20810 gave a tuple: (('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1', 'O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F'),)

So retrosynthetic step: target splits into two fragments: fragment A = CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1 (call it fragment A) and fragment B = O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F (fragment B). Good.

Step2: apply template 2895 to fragment B? Actually we applied to fragment B and got empty result (no match). Then applied to fragment A and got nitrated version: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1. So template 2895 transforms fragment A to nitrated version (adds nitro). So step2: fragment A -> nitrated fragment A'.

Now step3: apply template 1914397 to nitrated fragment A' gave two fragments: ('CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). So fragment A' splits into fragment C = CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1 (a protected piperazine with tBu ester) and fragment D = O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2 (a brominated nitro aromatic fused ring).

Step4: apply template 1914398 to fragment D gave ('BrBr', 'O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2'). So fragment D splits into fragment E = BrBr (bromine molecule?) and fragment F = O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2 (nitro aromatic without bromine). So step4.

Now need step5: template 1914399 applied to something. Likely to fragment F? Let's try applying to fragment F.
